video_title: Vlade Divac | Kings vs Lakers 2002 WCF Collapse, NBA’s WILDEST Prank Ever

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac on his decision to join the Sacramento Kings
quotes.excerpt: I chose Sacramento, and everybody said my lot of my friends from LA, why? The worst team, why? I said, that's what I want.
quotes.quote: I finished my journey in Charlotte, and I became a free agent. I didn't want to move my family, especially kids from the school and their friends from LA. So they stayed in LA a while I was playing in Charlotte. I knew I'm coming back to the West Coast. I had a few offers. I remember Denver, maybe Phoenix, Clippers, which I didn't want to play for. I chose Sacramento, and everybody said my lot of my friends from LA, why? The worst team, why? I said, that's what I want. I want to go somewhere where I can build something. And luckily, Jeff Petrie, who was a great GM, built that team, bringing Chris Webber. They had drafted Peja Stojakovic a few years before, so he came the same year. They drafted Jason Williams. So it was a lot of fun.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac on the 2002 Kings' lack of experience
quotes.excerpt: The only thing we didn't have, experience. Except me, nobody had the experience playing in finals.

text_blocks.speaker: Vlade Divac
text_blocks.text: Everything, the chemistry, the team is ready to go to the next level, the way we played, we felt so confident. The only thing we didn't have, experience. Except me, nobody had the experience playing in finals. A Lakers already, you know, went through that process. Remember when they signed Shaq and Kobe, they they couldn't get to the finals for two, three years.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac on the infamous 2002 WCF game-winning tip
quotes.excerpt: Basketball is a game where you have to think fast, or not think, just do it.
quotes.quote: Basketball is a game where you have to think fast, or not think, just do it. Believe it or not, in that moment, I'm thinking about Portland Trail Blazers, Lakers at the Forum, 91. Terry Porter takes the shot from the corner, missed the shot, we are up one. Magic got the ball, what he did, he rolled the ball all the way down the end for time to expire. So my thought process is basically knock the ball down. Shaq is behind me, Kobe is trying, so I know it's a few seconds left. So basketball is a game where you have to think fast, or not think, just do it. Believe it or not, in that moment, I'm thinking about Portland Trail Blazers, Lakers at the Forum, 91. Terry Porter takes the shot from the corner, missed the shot, we are up one. Magic got the ball, what he did, he rolled the ball all the way down the end for time to expire. So my thought process is basically knock the ball down.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac on Chris Webber's leadership
quotes.excerpt: Chris Webber was the leader of the team. He was an All-Star, he was the clutch player for us.
quotes.quote: Chris Webber was the leader of the team. He was an All-Star, he was the clutch player for us. I was there to help everybody do their thing. If Peja Stojakovic is a great shooter, so I was there to make sure he got his open shots. Mike Bibby was an unbelievable point guard, but also scorer, so I was there to make sure that he got his part. And obviously, leaving Chris Webber in the paint to do his things. So I was very, I would say, coach on the floor, trying to make sure everybody is in the right spot.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac on his early days with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Rudy was the guy who drove me to the practice. I was living in the Marina City Club.
quotes.quote: Rudy Tomjanovich was the equipment manager. When I came in 1989, because I didn't have a driver license, so he was the guy who drove me to the practice. I was living in the Marina City Club, so he would come pick me up and we would practice at Loyola.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac on his prank involving Lucy Liu
quotes.excerpt: I asked her, can you write a note? And she said, hi Tony, this is Lucy Liu, give me a call.
quotes.quote: I asked her, can you write a note? And she said, hi Tony, this is Lucy Liu, give me a call and left the number. So I gave the note to the security, he goes to Tony Bobbitt. He said, Tony, this is from Lucy Liu. So I'm watching from the angle, and I see Tony looking the paper, putting it in a pocket. So I know he's going to start calling, but that's my number. He doesn't know. So he starts leaving messages, right? So I don't want to pick it up. I call him back actually during our practice, but I told one girl, I made specifically a job for her to call him between 11 and 1:00 where he cannot pick up the phone and leave the message and leave the love stories.

quotes.speaker: Vlade Divac
quotes.summary_phrase: Vlade Divac on Jerry West's impact
quotes.excerpt: I have to give the credit to Lakers organization, specifically to Jerry West. He saw something.
quotes.quote: I have to give the credit to Lakers organization, specifically to Jerry West. He saw something. Actually, he changed the game today. Bringing guys overseas, you know, before you had nobody. Now it's last six years, MVPs of the league are internationals. How about that?
